name: Graph Match: Function Transformations
description: Algebra 2 transformations game: students drag a, h and k sliders (or the curve's key point) to make y = a·f(x − h) + k land on a target curve. Auto-graded: 2 points per graph matched without a hint, 1 with a hint. Teachers pick the target functions, which sliders are unlocked, the match tolerance, checks per graph and hint/equation options in the settings editor.
author: Virtual Arkansas
